    Periodic components are connected stable translation quivers #

    Proof of Proposition 5.3, reduction to components (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex): on a finite translation quiver, a periodic component K is closed under τ^{±1} and every vertex of K is the translate of a vertex of K, so the full translation subquiver on K is stable; it is connected by arrows and translation edges.
